Potion attribute-removal callback calls super then submits end sound BEFORE type-dispatched aftermath. Exact slave→fresh original-type actor spawn request then old drop-disable/death, no insertion transaction. Client convert may returnnull, so callback safety depends on native contract not established.
LivingUpdate effect presence requests xyz stateFX including slaves; attack refusal independently requests xyz ringFX regardless psychic hit success. Source-position floats and requested20/24/40 lifetimes are static presentation inputs, not measured visibility/lifetime. Random step loops can choose0; no deterministic finite iteration bound established.

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation:
Fixed real entity registry creates Vallumraptor, attribute subscriber binds its attributes, ClientProxy binds VallumraptorRenderer, and complete mod constructor registers entity registry and CommonEvents on event bus. Registry/proxy reads are bounded binding declarations rather than claimed full containing initializers.
Complete native subclass defines HIDING_FOR sync integer default0, local hideProgress/prevHideProgress, and local fleeTicks/fleeFromPosition. In tick, after super.tick, hideProgress moves +1 toward20 while hideFor>0 and -1 toward0 after <=0. Health recovery requests heal2 on entity tick modulo15 while hiding versus100 otherwise, provided below max; this has no surrounding server-only guard.
Server-only block decrements positive hideFor by1 and positive relaxed timer; fleeTicks decrements in another server-only block. Later tick code, outside those explicit guards, examines its own current target: nonnull/alive/notcreativePlayer. If tame, health<max*.45 and hideFor<=0, chooses80..119, writes hideFor, fleeFromPosition=target position and fleeTicks=same i. If that current threat is Mob, requests setTarget(null), setLastHurtByMob(null) and setLastHurtMob(null).
Fresh hiding is not directly qualified by current hurt success. Its entire trigger is native tick state, and because countdown decrement precedes the trigger, expiration may immediately re-enter if lowHP/tame/threat still qualify. There is no separate hide-rearm cooldown or attack-attempt lease consumption in this complete subclass.
Complete CommonEvents.livingFindTarget cancels LivingChangeTarget when the new target is this class with hideFor>0, first requesting mob.setTarget(null). Complete livingTick also server-clears a Mob current target when it is a hiding Vallumraptor. The recurring sweep only clears target; the broader revenge/lastHurt clearing belongs to the selected threat at entry, not every observer.
Registered embedded FleeGoal requires positive fleeTicks and nonnull flee origin; tick sets running and navigates away only when current navigation is done, with hide-dependent search span4 versus8. stop nulls fleeFromPosition and sets running false; it does not clear hideFor or explicitly stop navigation. The hide countdown, flee timer, goal lifecycle and graphic progress are separate state lifetimes.
Complete own NBT methods save/load Elder, RelaxedTime and JustLootedChest while delegating super. There are no own HIDING_FOR/fleeTicks/flee origin/hideProgress keys; no durable hide lease/reload restoration is asserted. Natural expiry lets numeric hide reach0; visual progress fades independently and can still be positive after the target refusal condition ends.
Complete renderer.scale sets model alpha to1-.9*interpolatedHideProgress, nominally .1 at full progress rather than invisible. getRenderType uses hideProgress(1)>0 to force entityTranslucent; actual model setter and complete renderToBuffer multiply alphaIn by stored alpha. This graphic gate is not the integer hideFor>0 admission gate. Held ItemLayer renders its item without passing that model alpha or testing hideFor, so matching held-object fade is not established.
Complete own melee goal has no hideFor check in canUse/checkAndDealDamage; canUse instead checks live target, not dancing, not creativePlayer, and outbound damage still depends on LOS/range. Higher-priority FleeGoal uses MOVE and may affect scheduling, so this is not a claim attacks always run during hiding. Neither graphical fade nor target-event cancellation proves damage immunity or universal AI/control refusal.
No custom per-refusal text, reason packet, per-attempt flash or rejection sound occurs in the read target refusal listeners. Body alpha is state presentation. Existing generic eating/ambient/attack sounds and entity event45 are not refusal acknowledgments.
Numeric hideFor is the AI-target refusal gate. Local interpolated hideProgress is a separate graphic lifetime; progress updates before numeric decrement, so fading or translucent body does not establish current protection.
Low-health trigger requires tame, retained live noncreative threat and nonpositive timer. Recovery requests occur earlier and may change eligibility; renewal is conditional, not guaranteed or a forever-safe state.
Flee origin/timer are shared with chest theft and the separate wild-prey escape branch. afterSteal can replace them with a different origin and longer timer, so fleeing and hiding cannot be treated as one inseparable lease.
Only the entry-selected threat receives revenge/last-hurt clear requests. The registered recurring Mob sweep clears only current target. The protected entity own melee predicate has no hide gate, but MOVE priority matters.
Complete own subclass has no hide-specific hurt override. Bounded Dinosaur base identity/initialization reading does not prove absence of inherited or other listener protections. No universal damage or control immunity claimed.
Coordinator reread every proposed source range, complete entity/renderer/melee and complete two target listeners; large registry/proxy ranges are limited binding declarations. Only alpha declaration and complete setter/render methods of model were read, not whole model/art. Six prior substantive decision records read, not six source chains.

No explicit server-only guard surrounds the lowHP hide trigger or modulo recovery block, whereas countdown and retained-target sweep are server guarded. Do not claim random local trigger states converge or that all mutation is server-authoritative.

FleeGoal inherits default scheduling/continuation behavior not newly expanded. Stop does not explicitly stop navigation, and no geometry/pathfinding success is guaranteed. Own melee has no hide guard, but higher-priority MOVE goal matters.
Base Dinosaur class read only44..70 for identity/initialization; no claim of full inherited hurt/travel/effect policy. Complete subclass has no hide-specific hurt override, which is narrower than proving no other layer protects it.
Model read only alpha declaration and two complete alpha-consuming methods; no whole634line model, textures, animation design, pixels, occlusion, sound or render-backend acceptance. Transparent body retains nominal10percent opacity; no claim of total invisibility.

Latest ledger was read at proposal time to avoid accepted Underzealot/Raycat overlap. This immutable proposal does not edit current ledger/progress or satisfy any game/native acceptance or checklist deletion.
All statements are bounded source analysis. Hashes, 14 ranges, 9 files, model alpha, held-item layer, HP threshold and different species provide zero separate credit. No actual sound, PNG, game, TCP, loaded registry or performance acceptance.
Hidden graphic body is nominally10percent alpha, not full invisibility. Held item path has no same alpha parameter. Server guards differ across branches; neither event arbitration nor client/server convergence was exercised.

whole_mechanism_comparisons.concrete_observation: 一个原生状态伤源拒绝及真实状态回执重建整链1，两个ID codec/属性/producer/consumer不另计。拒伤针对任意已中sting的节肢来源，不限本hawk施加者；不是所有伤害免疫，也不是Boss拒控。效果和广播在doHurtTarget结果之外，不能将sting回执当HP受击成功。广播all players无生产端距离/维度筛选；接收只在本世界ID查类型，无UUID、dimension、sequence或实际攻击关系校验。包未携带amp/剩余duration，重建不能当完整权威状态镜像。

Player igniter-tag interaction separately triggers on server, requests item hurtAndBreak and side-success; no successful item-cost or creative-consumption proof.
While triggered and server, positive fear and !EXPLODING decrements positive CloseTime; only a subsequent evaluation at nonpositive time clears TRIGGERED. Otherwise it increments time until configured fuse, then alive permits EXPLODING=true. Fear decrements later in own tick. It is a renewable goal-written counter, not per-attacker/source throttling or an actual successful damage counter. A target may re-trigger through own AI; stopping one attempt is not persistent threat removal.
When EXPLODING alreadytrue the fear-decrement branch is disabled. Own tick advances separate local explodeProgress to5 then calls discard on either side, and on server calls explode only when transient spawnedExplosion false, setting true after method returns. Own class has no normal clear-EXPLODING path, but no global irreversibility, cross-mod absence, absolute wall-clock deadline or exactly-once successful explosion is proved.
explode creates registered NuclearExplosion without null guard after own discard, copies position and size1/1.75, requests noGrief when mobGriefing false and ignores addFreshEntity bool. Failed/null creation or add may leave no live emitted entity despite prior removal/warning. Local guard prevents a repeated returned call on that object; it is not durable exactly-once settlement.
NBT writes Charged and CloseTime only; own TRIGGERED/EXPLODING/catScareTime/progress/spawnedExplosion are not saved here. A reconstructed instance can retain positive CloseTime but default untriggered/nonexploding; source visual branch only needs positive progress/alive/notexploding, so persisted time and armed-state indicators can diverge. No live save/reload or all external state restoration proof.
closeProgress uses time sampled before current increment/decrement; sirenAngle uses previous closeProgress before new ratio. Progress not explicitly clamped, angle adds modulo increment rather than clamping total angle. Config declared default300/min20/maxINT; actual loaded config and arbitrary NBT values unverified. Ratios outside expected range cannot be universally excluded.
Renderer emits rotating green warning geometry only closeProgress>0,alive,!EXPLODING; uses sqrtprogress*3 length and(1-sqrtprogress)*1.25 width. It does not additionally test TRIGGERED. Model setup moves head/cores by progress and compresses base by explodeProgress; exact model offsets map warning origin. No pixel/art/frame registration/pose evaluation native acceptance; geometry design is not independently counted.
Glow sinusoidal alpha nominal0.5..1 is not trigger/refusal-specific; button texture cycles tick/5 vs charged tick/2. Explosion overlay alpha tracks separate explodeProgress. Alpha eyes explicitly EQUAL depth, warning light render type no explicit depth-test setting and different output target; do not claim wall penetration or same depth policy. Charged layer adapter delegates power gating to unexpanded native EnergySwirlLayer, not new immune mechanics.
ClientProxy admits entity sound only client, caches case1 by integer entity ID and validates class/isSameEntity helper before reuse, queues only !isSoundPlaying&&canPlaySound. Nucleeper.remove calls clearSoundCacheFor, whose body only removes map entry; this does not by itself prove running sound stop. Actual NucleeperSound is absent, so helper identity, volume/pitch, mute/stop and stopped-instance behavior not verified. No audible sound was played.
Triggered server periodically requests nearby siren POIs on(tickCount+id)%10==0 within256; then instance check calls setNearestNuclearBomb. Interface shouldStopBlaringSirens returns(!triggered&&!exploding)||removed. Actual NuclearSirenBlockEntity and NuclearSirenSound absent: no proof nearest/range/fairness/save/renewal/stop/audio. Requests and interface contract are bounded only.
Emitted NuclearExplosion full tick/removal/serialization read: noGrief gates world block work, not outer living-entity damage/effect/motion loop. The latter is not explicitly server-guarded in this class, ignores hurt/addEffect results and assigns delta movement independent of hurt success. Raycat damage becomes0 but effect is still requested and velocity is set from zero damage; radiation-resistant tag and Tremorzilla special branches depend on actual tag data not loaded here. This is contextual sink behavior, no new immunity-family credit.
Full explosion class requests chunk loading/unloading server-side and only saves WasLoadingChunks; size/noGrief/intentional flags and destroying stack not saved here. create/add/body feedback do not prove world damage, successful effects or safe reload. Its block-carving and egg transformation side paths are supporting context0; no architecture/ecology/native material credit.
One adjacent counterplay/anticipation feedback family, not a hurt/control-immunity implementation: externally renewed avoidance lease reverses an existing local countdown before EXPLODING; warning state, preparation cancellation and emitted entity outcome remain distinct.
Native AvoidEntityGoal is now read complete: combat targeting plus range/selection, random away position, not-closer check and a nonnull path gate admission. Continuation checks navigation unfinished, not current cat distance or liveness. Scheduler timing and successful navigation remain unexpanded; fear20 is refreshed only when this registered anonymous goal actually ticks.
EXPLODING disables the fear rollback branch, not every later mutable operation. Local explodeProgress reaches5 only on a later evaluation after the flag was set. Discard occurs before create/add; create is unchecked and returned add result is ignored. No durable exactly-once explosion is asserted.
NucleeperSound complete source now proves canPlay checks silent+triggered, while tick checks alive+triggered but not silent and does not explicitly stop on EXPLODING. Own remove clears cache; sound tick separately requests stop when no longer alive/triggered. The cache identity is alive+integer ID only, not UUID or dimension; case1 lacks old.isStopped recreation guard, so reusing a stopped matching instance is possible in source, not a tested restart failure.
Sound progress can be stale versus current countdown: time sampled before this tick update; sirenAngle uses previous progress; neither ratio nor sqrt input is clamped. Ordinary valid default progress is not proof arbitrary persisted CloseTime/config always produces finite bounded pitch/geometry.
Siren complete block installs ticker; state owner computes powered/volume before clearing stale bomb pointer. setNearestNuclearBomb replaces only a closer pointer, does not reject inactive/removed input first and holds no list of alternatives. Clearing one does not promote a farther source without another request. These are exact call-order boundaries, not a measured missed alarm.
Siren bomb pointer itself is not persisted; integer BombID and optional furnace coordinates are. load/getUpdateTag/packet apply do not resolve bomb identity; missing BombID getInt yields0 and omitted furnace coordinates do not explicitly clear an existing field. Constructor volume reflects POWERED only, not a loaded BombID. Server clearing/re-requests and native network/save order were not run.
BlockEntityTickableSound uses looping+linear attenuation and position-only helper identity. ClientProxy case0 recreates stopped objects whereas entity case1 does not. NuclearSirenSound tick updates volume until block removal, including zero volume after deactivation; canPlay is an admission test, not its tick stop predicate. No audible or engine scheduler guarantee.
Emitted explosion noGrief only gates block work. Living scan has no explicit server guard; hurt/effect results are unchecked and velocity set separately. Query is a box, and calculateDamage is unclamped, so negative damage-derived inward velocity outside spherical maximum is possible by source arithmetic; no reproduced motion or damage result. Raycat suppression does not cancel effect request.
Distinct from nonrenewing refused-hit refractory wake windows, coalesced refusal charge, successful-hurt cooldown retaliation, committed NPC/victim ritual, animation phase denial, attack-attempt release, permanent goal rewrite and combat-revoked offhand pacification. whole_mechanism_comparisons.full_chain_observation:
Actual registered chain: @Mod constructor installs setup; ChampionCapability.register installs both event handlers; concrete ShieldingAffix is put into ID/category registry. LivingEntity+Enemy qualification attaches capability. Spawn/JoinWorld without rank installs selected affixes and invokes initial callbacks, but Shielding inherits empty onInitialSpawn/onSpawn. No default active mode or initial sync is implied.
On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. There is no deterministic finite active deadline or two-second shield lease in this code.
Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true). No amount>0, attacker owner, per-hit RNG, hit budget, resource debit or source tag predicate. Later true returns cannot undo cancellation, iteration does not short-circuit until after all target affixes; then canceled skips attacker callbacks. Native Forge dispatch of an already-canceled event is not expanded.
BasicAffix sends concrete affix data through registered SPacketSyncAffixData. Codec carries integer entity ID, affix ID and CompoundTag only. Enqueued consumer checks current world/capability/mapped affix and applies readSyncTag/saveData; no UUID/dimension/generation, pending replay or delivery acknowledgment. A handled packet is not proof state applied. Native channel scheduling and world lifetime unexecuted.
Actual StartTracking sends SPacketSyncChampion rank/color/affix names, without mode. Its client consumer installs rank/list; no concrete Shielding callback supplies current state initially. Under fresh empty client data and already-active server state, observer can lack true display until a later toggle; that first successful toggle may be false. This is a conditional source boundary, not live desynchronization reproduced or bounded wait.
Client onLivingUpdate invokes installed affix onClientUpdate before rank showParticles condition. Shielding true local mode requests one white ENTITY_EFFECT at random body position each delivered update. showParticles gate controls later rank particles, not Shielding particles. This state presentation differs from unthrottled per-incoming-attack no-damage sound; neither is a proven target-authenticated refusal receipt or native delivered sensory evidence.
Client.setAffixes clears its list but not idToAffix or data maps. A removed mapped affix can still accept an ID state packet, while no longer in tick list; previously received data need not be fresh default on reused capability. AffixData constructs a data object and reads side map; reflection can return null with unchecked callers. Native CompoundTag missing/wrong-type semantics not expanded; fresh Java boolean field alone is not proof of all decoded tag defaults.

whole_mechanism_comparisons.limitations:
One stochastic stateful admission/feedback lifecycle at most1. Not one credit each for NBT, packet, source exception, particles, sound, registry, random parameter or side maps.
Shielding is damage attack cancellation, not blanket movement/control/effect immunity. OUT_OF_WORLD identity bypass is local to this affix, not proof every other affix or native gate accepts.
Conditional negative example: server mode already true and a fresh observer receives only the affix-name snapshot. The client has no true mode to display until an applicable later state packet. The next successful inversion is false, so receiving that packet can leave it visually off through the whole unseen true phase. No claim of guaranteed live reproduction or bounded wait.
Client.setAffixes clears the visible list but not idToAffix/data. A previously mapped removed affix can still accept an ID packet and retain data; it is no longer ticked if absent from list. Integer entity ID alone does not authenticate the old actor lifetime. These are contextual limitations, not separate proposals.
Affine data getter reflection can return null on construction error; callers lack null handling. Normal BooleanData missing mode uses native getBoolean behavior, whose implementation was not expanded in this batch.
No shield initial-on state or startup sync inferred from registration; Shielding inherits empty callbacks. No active phase finite upper bound, hit-count limit, authoritative particle receipt or sound delivery guarantee.

complete_saved_substantive_decisions.full_chain_observation:
Actual mod constructor binds registry and client setup; deferred NUCLEEPER factory and attributes plus actual renderer registration exist. Research does not claim natural spawn deployment or installed runtime/API compatibility.
Complete registerGoals registers higher priority AvoidEntityGoal Raycat radius10 with tick calling super then catScareTime=20; MeleeGoal requires live target and moves to it, triggering within3.5+target width without explicit LOS/trigger reset on leaving. AvoidEntityGoal/GoalSelector engine admission internals not expanded, so not every cat in radius is proven to renew fear. Player igniter-tag interaction separately triggers on server, requests item hurtAndBreak and side-success; no successful item-cost or creative-consumption proof.
While triggered and server, positive fear and !EXPLODING decrements positive CloseTime; only a subsequent evaluation at nonpositive time clears TRIGGERED. Otherwise it increments time until configured fuse, then alive permits EXPLODING=true. Fear decrements later in own tick. It is a renewable goal-written counter, not per-attacker/source throttling or an actual successful damage counter. A target may re-trigger through own AI; stopping one attempt is not persistent threat removal.
When EXPLODING alreadytrue the fear-decrement branch is disabled. Own tick advances separate local explodeProgress to5 then calls discard on either side, and on server calls explode only when transient spawnedExplosion false, setting true after method returns. Own class has no normal clear-EXPLODING path, but no global irreversibility, cross-mod absence, absolute wall-clock deadline or exactly-once successful explosion is proved.
explode creates registered NuclearExplosion without null guard after own discard, copies position and size1/1.75, requests noGrief when mobGriefing false and ignores addFreshEntity bool. Failed/null creation or add may leave no live emitted entity despite prior removal/warning. Local guard prevents a repeated returned call on that object; it is not durable exactly-once settlement.
NBT writes Charged and CloseTime only; own TRIGGERED/EXPLODING/catScareTime/progress/spawnedExplosion are not saved here. A reconstructed instance can retain positive CloseTime but default untriggered/nonexploding; source visual branch only needs positive progress/alive/notexploding, so persisted time and armed-state indicators can diverge. No live save/reload or all external state restoration proof.
closeProgress uses time sampled before current increment/decrement; sirenAngle uses previous closeProgress before new ratio. Progress not explicitly clamped, angle adds modulo increment rather than clamping total angle. Config declared default300/min20/maxINT; actual loaded config and arbitrary NBT values unverified. Ratios outside expected range cannot be universally excluded.
Renderer emits rotating green warning geometry only closeProgress>0,alive,!EXPLODING; uses sqrtprogress*3 length and(1-sqrtprogress)*1.25 width. It does not additionally test TRIGGERED. Model setup moves head/cores by progress and compresses base by explodeProgress; exact model offsets map warning origin. No pixel/art/frame registration/pose evaluation native acceptance; geometry design is not independently counted.
Glow sinusoidal alpha nominal0.5..1 is not trigger/refusal-specific; button texture cycles tick/5 vs charged tick/2. Explosion overlay alpha tracks separate explodeProgress. Alpha eyes explicitly EQUAL depth, warning light render type no explicit depth-test setting and different output target; do not claim wall penetration or same depth policy. Charged layer adapter delegates power gating to unexpanded native EnergySwirlLayer, not new immune mechanics.
ClientProxy admits entity sound only client, caches case1 by integer entity ID and validates class/isSameEntity helper before reuse, queues only !isSoundPlaying&&canPlaySound. Nucleeper.remove calls clearSoundCacheFor, whose body only removes map entry; this does not by itself prove running sound stop. Actual NucleeperSound is absent, so helper identity, volume/pitch, mute/stop and stopped-instance behavior not verified. No audible sound was played.
Triggered server periodically requests nearby siren POIs on(tickCount+id)%10==0 within256; then instance check calls setNearestNuclearBomb. Interface shouldStopBlaringSirens returns(!triggered&&!exploding)||removed. Actual NuclearSirenBlockEntity and NuclearSirenSound absent: no proof nearest/range/fairness/save/renewal/stop/audio. Requests and interface contract are bounded only.
Emitted NuclearExplosion full tick/removal/serialization read: noGrief gates world block work, not outer living-entity damage/effect/motion loop. The latter is not explicitly server-guarded in this class, ignores hurt/addEffect results and assigns delta movement independent of hurt success. Raycat damage becomes0 but effect is still requested and velocity is set from zero damage; radiation-resistant tag and Tremorzilla special branches depend on actual tag data not loaded here. This is contextual sink behavior, no new immunity-family credit.
Full explosion class requests chunk loading/unloading server-side and only saves WasLoadingChunks; size/noGrief/intentional flags and destroying stack not saved here. create/add/body feedback do not prove world damage, successful effects or safe reload. Its block-carving and egg transformation side paths are supporting context0; no architecture/ecology/native material credit.
One adjacent counterplay/anticipation feedback family, not a hurt/control-immunity implementation: externally renewed avoidance lease reverses an existing local countdown before EXPLODING; warning state, preparation cancellation and emitted entity outcome remain distinct.
Native AvoidEntityGoal is now read complete: combat targeting plus range/selection, random away position, not-closer check and a nonnull path gate admission. Continuation checks navigation unfinished, not current cat distance or liveness. Scheduler timing and successful navigation remain unexpanded; fear20 is refreshed only when this registered anonymous goal actually ticks.
EXPLODING disables the fear rollback branch, not every later mutable operation. Local explodeProgress reaches5 only on a later evaluation after the flag was set. Discard occurs before create/add; create is unchecked and returned add result is ignored. No durable exactly-once explosion is asserted.
NucleeperSound complete source now proves canPlay checks silent+triggered, while tick checks alive+triggered but not silent and does not explicitly stop on EXPLODING. Own remove clears cache; sound tick separately requests stop when no longer alive/triggered. The cache identity is alive+integer ID only, not UUID or dimension; case1 lacks old.isStopped recreation guard, so reusing a stopped matching instance is possible in source, not a tested restart failure.
Sound progress can be stale versus current countdown: time sampled before this tick update; sirenAngle uses previous progress; neither ratio nor sqrt input is clamped. Ordinary valid default progress is not proof arbitrary persisted CloseTime/config always produces finite bounded pitch/geometry.
Siren complete block installs ticker; state owner computes powered/volume before clearing stale bomb pointer. setNearestNuclearBomb replaces only a closer pointer, does not reject inactive/removed input first and holds no list of alternatives. Clearing one does not promote a farther source without another request. These are exact call-order boundaries, not a measured missed alarm.
Siren bomb pointer itself is not persisted; integer BombID and optional furnace coordinates are. load/getUpdateTag/packet apply do not resolve bomb identity; missing BombID getInt yields0 and omitted furnace coordinates do not explicitly clear an existing field. Constructor volume reflects POWERED only, not a loaded BombID. Server clearing/re-requests and native network/save order were not run.
BlockEntityTickableSound uses looping+linear attenuation and position-only helper identity. ClientProxy case0 recreates stopped objects whereas entity case1 does not. NuclearSirenSound tick updates volume until block removal, including zero volume after deactivation; canPlay is an admission test, not its tick stop predicate. No audible or engine scheduler guarantee.
Emitted explosion noGrief only gates block work. Living scan has no explicit server guard; hurt/effect results are unchecked and velocity set separately. Query is a box, and calculateDamage is unclamped, so negative damage-derived inward velocity outside spherical maximum is possible by source arithmetic; no reproduced motion or damage result. Raycat suppression does not cancel effect request.
Distinct from nonrenewing refused-hit refractory wake windows, coalesced refusal charge, successful-hurt cooldown retaliation, committed NPC/victim ritual, animation phase denial, attack-attempt release, permanent goal rewrite and combat-revoked offhand pacification. Ten selected actual substantive decision fields were read, not all461 decisions or their old source chains.

complete_saved_substantive_decisions.full_chain_observation:
Actual registered chain: @Mod constructor installs setup; ChampionCapability.register installs both event handlers; concrete ShieldingAffix is put into ID/category registry. LivingEntity+Enemy qualification attaches capability. Spawn/JoinWorld without rank installs selected affixes and invokes initial callbacks, but Shielding inherits empty onInitialSpawn/onSpawn. No default active mode or initial sync is implied.
On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. There is no deterministic finite active deadline or two-second shield lease in this code.
Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true). No amount>0, attacker owner, per-hit RNG, hit budget, resource debit or source tag predicate. Later true returns cannot undo cancellation, iteration does not short-circuit until after all target affixes; then canceled skips attacker callbacks. Native Forge dispatch of an already-canceled event is not expanded.
BasicAffix sends concrete affix data through registered SPacketSyncAffixData. Codec carries integer entity ID, affix ID and CompoundTag only. Enqueued consumer checks current world/capability/mapped affix and applies readSyncTag/saveData; no UUID/dimension/generation, pending replay or delivery acknowledgment. A handled packet is not proof state applied. Native channel scheduling and world lifetime unexecuted.
Actual StartTracking sends SPacketSyncChampion rank/color/affix names, without mode. Its client consumer installs rank/list; no concrete Shielding callback supplies current state initially. Under fresh empty client data and already-active server state, observer can lack true display until a later toggle; that first successful toggle may be false. This is a conditional source boundary, not live desynchronization reproduced or bounded wait.
Client onLivingUpdate invokes installed affix onClientUpdate before rank showParticles condition. Shielding true local mode requests one white ENTITY_EFFECT at random body position each delivered update. showParticles gate controls later rank particles, not Shielding particles. This state presentation differs from unthrottled per-incoming-attack no-damage sound; neither is a proven target-authenticated refusal receipt or native delivered sensory evidence.

hurt先Entity.isInvulnerableTo，再排WITHER_IMMUNE_TO tag和causing WitherBoss；invul>0且非BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY拒绝。其后powered(HP<=max/2)拒direct AbstractArrow，再拒非Player的同MobType Living causing实体。BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY在这里仅跳召唤期门，不自动跳箭/同族等后续门。实际tag内容未读。

actual_fourfield_projection.full_chain_observation:
Own constructor instantiates eight parent-bound parts, MAX_HEALTH attribute200, native initial HOVERING manager and DATA_PHASE initialization; phase enum maps11 actual classes, manager lazily caches instances, ends prior phase, server-writes phase ID then begins new phase.
Part.hurt first consults own isInvulnerableTo, then passes actual part to parent. Server root.hurt passes body; root client returns false. Parent multipart overload has no own explicit side gate; do not assert every part call independently server-gated.
Whole parent admission: current DYING rejects before onHurt; current phase onHurt runs before non-head amount/4+min(amount,1); resulting amount<.01 rejects; otherwise only Player owner or ALWAYS_HURTS_ENDER_DRAGONS tag calls reallyHurt. Other source returns true without calling native parent damage.
AbstractDragonSittingPhase onHurt lights direct AbstractArrow for1second then returns0. Other sources inherit unchanged amount. Phase/refusal mutates the direct arrow before source eligibility; no refusal text/unique status/target-window feedback produced here. Lighting is a source state request, not measured pixels/audio.
Crucial subtype boundary: initial HOVERING reports isSitting true but inherits AbstractDragonPhaseInstance.onHurt unchanged, not AbstractDragonSittingPhase. Sitting-budget eligibility must not be equated with arrow-refusal eligibility.
For eligible source capture f=current HP then invoke reallyHurt->LivingEntity.hurt; wrapper ignores bool. Afterward current phase is queried again, so no claim of a captured immutable phase across parent hooks. If HP<=0 and then-current phase not sitting, setHealth1 and switch DYING.
If then-current phase is sitting, add f-currentHP to private sittingDamageReceived, regardless native hurt bool. Strictly >.25*maxHP resets accumulator0 and requests TAKEOFF. Exactly25% does not trigger. This is observed pre/post HP difference, not raw attack amount nor success-event nominal damage quota.
Private accumulator has only declaration and update/threshold/reset occurrences in complete root lexical screen; phase begin/end/ordinary takeoff and landing methods contain no accumulator reset. Native own save/read writes DragonPhase and DragonDeathTime, not accumulator. Do not infer external serializers or full replacement/load execution.
Native LivingEntity.hurt has attack hook/invulnerability/client/dead/fire/iframe gates, actuallyHurt applies hurt hook/armor/magic/absorption/final damage hook and setHealth. Full methods read; the attack, hurt and damage hook consumers, armor helper and parent death/totem internals are bounded external calls, not independently read implementations or success receipts.
Native hurt may perform death/sound/broadcast/knockback before returning. Root later HP1/phase change does not prove undo of die side effects or successful runtime survival. Return true is not final HP, phase, control or payment proof.
Whole relevant phase lifecycle: landing resets flame count then scanning; scanning can takeoff/charge without damage, attacking timed roar enters flaming; flaming expiry scans or takesoff, end discards owned cloud. Switching away therefore has source-visible teardown independent of whether damage admission represented HP loss. Cloud admission bool ignored, no runtime ecology/material credit.
Complete root aiStep dispatches current phase server tick, then at most one further tick if instance changed; client executes doClientTick and DATA_PHASE callback updates manager. Existing phase source sound/particles are separate state cues, not a bespoke denial feedback policy; no packet delivery/render/audio quality claim.
DYING phase server tick requests HP1 only while target distance squared in[100,22500] and no horizontal/vertical collision, else0. Root death tick handles death clock/XP/removal/fight callback. Path selection, world callbacks, death-loop trigger and actual observed timing remain outside this policy review.
Crystal heal direct setHealth happens before phase tick and is not an inverse edit of damage accumulator; nearest-crystal destruction requests head explosion damage10 then invokes current phase destruction handler. Tag membership, complete explosive event origin and ordinary End fight creation are not expanded.
actual_fourfield_projection.concrete_observation:
The policy is phase-managed measurement of actual pre/post native health followed by phase retirement and teardown. All root/part source admission, arrow subclass response, helpers, cues, counters, manager and own persistence belong to one whole at most.
Parent multipart damage checks DYING, then phase onHurt, then nonhead scaling and .01 threshold. Only Player-owned or the actual ALWAYS_HURTS_ENDER_DRAGONS damage tag reaches reallyHurt; other admitted source returns true without parent damage.
AbstractDragonSittingPhase ignites a direct AbstractArrow for one second then returns zero before source-owner eligibility. HOVERING isSitting true but inherits unchanged onHurt from AbstractDragonPhaseInstance. Boolean sitting is not arrow-denial subtype identity.
Parent records f=getHealth, invokes superclass hurt and ignores its return, then re-queries current phase. This is not a frozen phase lease across hook consumers.
In then-current sitting phase f-currentHP feeds sittingDamageReceived; strictly above .25*maxHP resets zero and requests TAKEOFF. Exactly threshold stays. An absorbed/canceled hit can contribute zero; hook-induced heal can algebraically reduce the counter. No demonstrated exploit or runtime outcome.
Observed-HP accumulation differs from Lycanites successfed nominal per-second quota+nexttick rollback and Minister refused-hit staff nominal expenditure. It also differs from Wilden absolute HP threshold clamp and Gaia elapsed phase timers. These whole prior owners remain zero extra.
Closest Draconic whole already owns source/part/phase gates, true-without-HP and nonstationary lethal HP1/DYING support, so those overlapping ideas are zero new. Its complete523..584 does not measure and accumulate sitting HP deltas to retire via TAKEOFF; this measured-delta lifecycle supports at most one related whole, no universal novelty claim.
Manager end-before-new-instance/server DATA_PHASE-write/begin and root at-most-one immediate second server phase tick are actual source transitions. Phase-owned flaming end discards its cloud. Normal source return is assumed; hook exceptions, network and engine scheduling are unproved.
Landing resets flame count; scanning may choose takeoff/charge without damage; attacking postincrements a40 tick condition then enters flaming; flaming200 or count4 can choose scan/takeoff. Those counters are not new research references or measured wall seconds.
Only root field declaration/update/threshold/reset occur in complete lexical search. Relevant complete phase begin/end methods show no additional accumulator reset. Own save/read persists DragonPhase/DragonDeathTime but omits accumulator; not full external serialization or native reopen proof.
LivingEntity hurt actuallyHurt apply hooks, invulnerability, side/dead, cooldown, armor/magic/absorption and final hook before health mutation, while broadcasts, knockback, death/totem calls may precede return. HP1 assignment after return cannot certify rollback of all death side effects or runtime resurrection.
Root crystal healing before phase dispatch uses direct setHealth and does not edit this accumulator. Crystal destruction requests head explosion10 then dispatches to current phase; exact merged tag contents and fight creation remain unreviewed.
Own addEffect/ride/dimension refusals are supporting context zero and cannot be treated as a complete generic control-immunity feedback implementation. Existing sounds/particles are phase/death cues without a new per-target denial receipt.

complete_original_object.full_chain_observation:
Actual registered chain: @Mod constructor installs setup; ChampionCapability.register installs both event handlers; concrete ShieldingAffix is put into ID/category registry. LivingEntity+Enemy qualification attaches capability. Spawn/JoinWorld without rank installs selected affixes and invokes initial callbacks, but Shielding inherits empty onInitialSpawn/onSpawn. No default active mode or initial sync is implied.
On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. There is no deterministic finite active deadline or two-second shield lease in this code.
Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true). No amount>0, attacker owner, per-hit RNG, hit budget, resource debit or source tag predicate. Later true returns cannot undo cancellation, iteration does not short-circuit until after all target affixes; then canceled skips attacker callbacks. Native Forge dispatch of an already-canceled event is not expanded.
BasicAffix sends concrete affix data through registered SPacketSyncAffixData. Codec carries integer entity ID, affix ID and CompoundTag only. Enqueued consumer checks current world/capability/mapped affix and applies readSyncTag/saveData; no UUID/dimension/generation, pending replay or delivery acknowledgment. A handled packet is not proof state applied. Native channel scheduling and world lifetime unexecuted.
Actual StartTracking sends SPacketSyncChampion rank/color/affix names, without mode. Its client consumer installs rank/list; no concrete Shielding callback supplies current state initially. Under fresh empty client data and already-active server state, observer can lack true display until a later toggle; that first successful toggle may be false. This is a conditional source boundary, not live desynchronization reproduced or bounded wait.
Client onLivingUpdate invokes installed affix onClientUpdate before rank showParticles condition. Shielding true local mode requests one white ENTITY_EFFECT at random body position each delivered update. showParticles gate controls later rank particles, not Shielding particles. This state presentation differs from unthrottled per-incoming-attack no-damage sound; neither is a proven target-authenticated refusal receipt or native delivered sensory evidence.
Client.setAffixes clears its list but not idToAffix or data maps. A removed mapped affix can still accept an ID state packet, while no longer in tick list; previously received data need not be fresh default on reused capability. AffixData constructs a data object and reads side map; reflection can return null with unchecked callers. Native CompoundTag missing/wrong-type semantics not expanded; fresh Java boolean field alone is not proof of all decoded tag defaults.
Conversion creates/uses different capability then copies rank/affix references and invokes empty Shielding initial callback; it does not explicitly copy old private data. Save reader hasUUID versus compound mismatch and generic maps remain existing migration owner28be6a, not fresh credit. No guaranteed native reload reset, natural champion spawn, cross-version1.20.1 support or all-affix certification.

Luna already owns source-category random resampling at its saved countdown; this boolean inversion can retain either phase without any deadline, and initial name-only snapshot omits current mode. Mode sync/particles/per-hit sound are one policy, not separate references. Migration28be6a already owns persistence/conversion/Adaptable memory, all supporting0 here. Original native collision now has query body: ProjectileUtil move vector starts from current position, clips blocks, then closest eligible entity along shortened segment; used level overload creates EntityHitResult(entity), and no source position write occurs here. Skull explosion uses current x/y/z after parent dispatch, not a promised ray-surface location. All world clip math and reentrant callbacks remain external.

Forge impact wrapper reads onProjectileImpactResult()!=DEFAULT. Nullable sister API is not the API this skull tick uses. Comments cannot substitute actual caller behavior.

Native Level chooses MOB explosion block policy from mobGriefing event and drop-decay rule. KEEP skips block destruction, not Explosion.explode entity computation. EntityBased calculator delegates resistance/shouldBlockExplode to actual skull; dangerous resistance cap is conditional, not final block admission. Fire=false prevents this explosion fire-placement branch.

Whole Explosion: ray resistance/geometry computes toBlow; Detonate publishes live block and entity lists, not a cancelable event. Its commented preliminary entity filter is disabled. Each eligible non-ignoreExplosion victim within normalized radius and nonzero direction is hurt after visibility factor. Returned hurt bool is ignored, then blast-protection-adjusted vector is added via setDeltaMovement and qualified players stored in hitPlayers. No final control result is returned; request is not actual displaced position and not necessarily ordinary knockback event.

Explosion Start cancellation makes Level return its constructed object before own explode/finalize, but ServerLevel outer nine-arg override still clears KEEP block list and sends packet to this level players with distanceSq<4096. A cancel-only listener that does not mutate/call the object leaves default empty blocks/hitPlayers; packet receives null motion aszero. Live maps/lists are exposed, so arbitrary listeners may alter this and no universal canceled-explosion-empty guarantee is made.

Complete packet carries coordinates/power/copied block list and three motion floats, not victim UUID/reason/accepted-effect/damage/canceled bit. Client handler ensures main thread, constructs client Explosion from packet, calls finalizeExplosion(true) and adds motion to current player delta. Thus even empty/cancel-only server outcome can request local explosion sound/particle; no actual visual/audio/network execution proof. Server and client are separate entity instances, so this is not a claim of double impulse on one object.

Whole Explosion.finalize uses client-side local sound, optional explosion particle, block list drops/requests if block policy allows, and optional fire. Its ordinary cue is independent of a specific victim accepted damage/control. Skull discard occurs after normal return of server explosion request whether hurt or effect was accepted; exception/reentry/restart/idempotent native receipt behavior not established.

full_chain_observation: WitherSkull extends the two actually-read native parents. AbstractHurtingProjectile.tick enters client or server-owner/chunk condition, calls Projectile.tick, queries ProjectileUtil, and only dispatches a non-MISS impact if the Forge impact hook does not cancel. Hook/query implementations not read.

Projectile.tick initializes hasBeenShot and tests leaving owner/root vehicle; parent canHitEntity first uses target.canBeHitByProjectile, then owner/leftOwner/shared-vehicle gate; AbstractHurtingProjectile further rejects noPhysics. This is local admission, not final target damage/control policy.

Projectile.onHit calls concrete onHitEntity then emits PROJECTILE_LAND at the hit location, or calls block.onProjectileHit then the block-position land event. Its native onHitEntity body is empty. No damage-success return is propagated by this dispatch.

Skull onHitEntity is server-only after super. Living owner selects witherSkull source8; true hurt then currently alive target requests enchantment damage effects, otherwise requests owner.heal5. Nonliving/missing owner instead selects magic5. Neither hurt=true nor !isAlive proves actual positive HP damage or this projectile causal kill; downstream bodies not read.

Only hurt=true plus living target enters difficulty choice: NORMAL10/HARD40 seconds, amplifier1 WITHER with effect source getOwner or projectile fallback. Easy/peaceful choose0 and no request. addEffect boolean is ignored; no explicit living-target still-alive gate before the request. Not an admitted-effect or immune-reason receipt.

Skull.onHit always continues after parent onHit returns; server requests power1 nonfire MOB explosion at current projectile x/y/z, then discard, independent of the local entity hurt bool. Hit point/event location and explosion current position must not be conflated. External exceptions/hooks/final explosion computation are outside read scope.

AbstractHurtingProjectile.tick has no explicit return after its onHit call; checkInsideBlocks, motion, inertia/water trail and setPos follow in this local method. That does not prove discarded entities visibly continue flight or establish client/server outcomes.

Skull own hurt alwaysfalse and isPickablefalse override the parent hurt deflection body that changes motion/owner. They do not prove universal external control immunity or an explicit refusal reason, and shouldBurnfalse/isOnFirefalse are not a full fire damage gate.

Dangerous flag defaultsfalse in synced data, changes inertia from parent0.95 to0.73 and caps block resistance at0.8 only when block canEntityDestroy. These are variants/helper state0, not separate examples or proof explosion block permission/success.

Parent cached owner UUID lookup/effect-source fallback, power persistence and spawn-packet owner id are support0. No sameUUID admission/material/payment/quest or production acceptance follows from any constructor, sound, game event, particles, discard or raw count.

actual_fourfield_projection.concrete_observation:
The policy is phase-managed measurement of actual pre/post native health followed by phase retirement and teardown. All root/part source admission, arrow subclass response, helpers, cues, counters, manager and own persistence belong to one whole at most.
Parent multipart damage checks DYING, then phase onHurt, then nonhead scaling and .01 threshold. Only Player-owned or the actual ALWAYS_HURTS_ENDER_DRAGONS damage tag reaches reallyHurt; other admitted source returns true without parent damage.
AbstractDragonSittingPhase ignites a direct AbstractArrow for one second then returns zero before source-owner eligibility. HOVERING isSitting true but inherits unchanged onHurt from AbstractDragonPhaseInstance. Boolean sitting is not arrow-denial subtype identity.
Parent records f=getHealth, invokes superclass hurt and ignores its return, then re-queries current phase. This is not a frozen phase lease across hook consumers.
In then-current sitting phase f-currentHP feeds sittingDamageReceived; strictly above .25*maxHP resets zero and requests TAKEOFF. Exactly threshold stays. An absorbed/canceled hit can contribute zero; hook-induced heal can algebraically reduce the counter. No demonstrated exploit or runtime outcome.
Observed-HP accumulation differs from Lycanites successfed nominal per-second quota+nexttick rollback and Minister refused-hit staff nominal expenditure. It also differs from Wilden absolute HP threshold clamp and Gaia elapsed phase timers. These whole prior owners remain zero extra.
Closest Draconic whole already owns source/part/phase gates, true-without-HP and nonstationary lethal HP1/DYING support, so those overlapping ideas are zero new. Its complete523..584 does not measure and accumulate sitting HP deltas to retire via TAKEOFF; this measured-delta lifecycle supports at most one related whole, no universal novelty claim.
Manager end-before-new-instance/server DATA_PHASE-write/begin and root at-most-one immediate second server phase tick are actual source transitions. Phase-owned flaming end discards its cloud. Normal source return is assumed; hook exceptions, network and engine scheduling are unproved.
Landing resets flame count; scanning may choose takeoff/charge without damage; attacking postincrements a40 tick condition then enters flaming; flaming200 or count4 can choose scan/takeoff. Those counters are not new research references or measured wall seconds.
Only root field declaration/update/threshold/reset occur in complete lexical search. Relevant complete phase begin/end methods show no additional accumulator reset. Own save/read persists DragonPhase/DragonDeathTime but omits accumulator; not full external serialization or native reopen proof.

HP1 assignment after return cannot certify rollback of all death side effects or runtime resurrection.

complete_original_object.full_chain_observation:
Actual registered chain: @Mod constructor installs setup; ChampionCapability.register installs both event handlers; concrete ShieldingAffix is put into ID/category registry. LivingEntity+Enemy qualification attaches capability. Spawn/JoinWorld without rank installs selected affixes and invokes initial callbacks, but Shielding inherits empty onInitialSpawn/onSpawn. No default active mode or initial sync is implied.
On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. There is no deterministic finite active deadline or two-second shield lease in this code.
Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true). No amount>0, attacker owner, per-hit RNG, hit budget, resource debit or source tag predicate. Later true returns cannot undo cancellation, iteration does not short-circuit until after all target affixes; then canceled skips attacker callbacks. Native Forge dispatch of an already-canceled event is not expanded.
BasicAffix sends concrete affix data through registered SPacketSyncAffixData. Codec carries integer entity ID, affix ID and CompoundTag only. Enqueued consumer checks current world/capability/mapped affix and applies readSyncTag/saveData; no UUID/dimension/generation, pending replay or delivery acknowledgment. A handled packet is not proof state applied. Native channel scheduling and world lifetime unexecuted.
Actual StartTracking sends SPacketSyncChampion rank/color/affix names, without mode. Its client consumer installs rank/list; no concrete Shielding callback supplies current state initially. Under fresh empty client data and already-active server state, observer can lack true display until a later toggle; that first successful toggle may be false. This is a conditional source boundary, not live desynchronization reproduced or bounded wait.
Client onLivingUpdate invokes installed affix onClientUpdate before rank showParticles condition. Shielding true local mode requests one white ENTITY_EFFECT at random body position each delivered update. showParticles gate controls later rank particles, not Shielding particles. This state presentation differs from unthrottled per-incoming-attack no-damage sound; neither is a proven target-authenticated refusal receipt or native delivered sensory evidence.
Client.setAffixes clears its list but not idToAffix or data maps. A removed mapped affix can still accept an ID state packet, while no longer in tick list; previously received data need not be fresh default on reused capability. AffixData constructs a data object and reads side map; reflection can return null with unchecked callers. Native CompoundTag missing/wrong-type semantics not expanded; fresh Java boolean field alone is not proof of all decoded tag defaults.
Conversion creates/uses different capability then copies rank/affix references and invokes empty Shielding initial callback; it does not explicitly copy old private data. Save reader hasUUID versus compound mismatch and generic maps remain existing migration owner28be6a, not fresh credit. No guaranteed native reload reset, natural champion spawn, cross-version1.20.1 support or all-affix certification.

Original native collision now has query body: ProjectileUtil move vector starts from current position, clips blocks, then closest eligible entity along shortened segment; used level overload creates EntityHitResult(entity), and no source position write occurs here. Skull explosion uses current x/y/z after parent dispatch, not a promised ray-surface location. All world clip math and reentrant callbacks remain external.

Forge impact wrapper reads onProjectileImpactResult()!=DEFAULT. Cancellation maps SKIP_ENTITY; every nonDEFAULT enum suppresses this AbstractHurtingProjectile.onHit call, even STOP names: this caller does not locally implement enum documentation by discarding/stopping. Nullable sister API is not the API this skull tick uses. Comments cannot substitute actual caller behavior.

Native Level chooses MOB explosion block policy from mobGriefing event and drop-decay rule. KEEP skips block destruction, not Explosion.explode entity computation. EntityBased calculator delegates resistance/shouldBlockExplode to actual skull; dangerous resistance cap is conditional, not final block admission. Fire=false prevents this explosion fire-placement branch.

Whole Explosion: ray resistance/geometry computes toBlow; Detonate publishes live block and entity lists, not a cancelable event. Its commented preliminary entity filter is disabled. Each eligible non-ignoreExplosion victim within normalized radius and nonzero direction is hurt after visibility factor. Returned hurt bool is ignored, then blast-protection-adjusted vector is added via setDeltaMovement and qualified players stored in hitPlayers. No final control result is returned; request is not actual displaced position and not necessarily ordinary knockback event.

Explosion Start cancellation makes Level return its constructed object before own explode/finalize, but ServerLevel outer nine-arg override still clears KEEP block list and sends packet to this level players with distanceSq<4096. A cancel-only listener that does not mutate/call the object leaves default empty blocks/hitPlayers; packet receives null motion aszero. Live maps/lists are exposed, so arbitrary listeners may alter this and no universal canceled-explosion-empty guarantee is made.

Complete packet carries coordinates/power/copied block list and three motion floats, not victim UUID/reason/accepted-effect/damage/canceled bit. Client handler ensures main thread, constructs client Explosion from packet, calls finalizeExplosion(true) and adds motion to current player delta. Thus even empty/cancel-only server outcome can request local explosion sound/particle; no actual visual/audio/network execution proof. Server and client are separate entity instances, so this is not a claim of double impulse on one object.

Whole Explosion.finalize uses client-side local sound, optional explosion particle, block list drops/requests if block policy allows, and optional fire. Its ordinary cue is independent of a specific victim accepted damage/control. Skull discard occurs after normal return of server explosion request whether hurt or effect was accepted; exception/reentry/restart/idempotent native receipt behavior not established.
